The '''Thovinack system''' was located in the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]], a part of<ref name="EAOC" /> the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Battle of Thovinack]], which took place shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|239|Thovinack, Battle of}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Thovinack system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-4.<ref name="TEA" />
